ITA-4.5.15 anupaśayaḥ अनुपशयः
Differential diagnosis upheld by negative treatment response
Signs and symptoms of aggravation signifying ineffective intervention of diet and medicines.; one of the diagnostic tools when a disease or condition cannot be interpreted merely by its clinical features.
ITA-

.1 anupānam अनुपानम्
Substance taken with or after medicine or food
A substance, usually liquid, which is taken with or after intake of a medicine or food.
ITA-

āyuḥ; dhāri; jīvitam; nityaga; anubandhaḥ आयुः ; धारि ; जीवितम् ; नित्यग ; अनुबन्धः
Life process, cycle or span
The coalescence of body, sense organs, mind and self that dynamically supports, nourishes and propagates itself despite its eventual disintegration. Ayurveda uses several terms as synonyms for life, based on the different perspectives under which they are understood: 1. Coalescence of body, sense organs, mind, and self; 2. Self-supporting, holding, ability of life to support and preserve itself; 3. Self-sustaining, self-nourishing, journey (of life), duration (of life), ability of life to nourish and sustain itself; 4. Ever moving forward, life’s ability to resist premature death and destruction through dynamic self-adaptation; 5. Uninterrupted succession, sequence, consequence, result, continuing link between past and future life.

ITA-1.11.7 anubandhaḥ अनुबन्धः
Consequence, longterm effect
Continuity of effect or long-term outcome, which includes the achievement of healthy longevity.
ITA-

anubandhaḥ अनुबन्धः
Secondary or dependent disease
A disease or condition which does not have an independent existence or line of treatment.
ITA-

anubandhyaḥ अनुबन्ध्यः
Primary or independent An independent disease or condition which has its own set of disease symptoms and classical line of treatment.

ITA-1.6.6 anumataḥ अनुमतः
Acceptance by not refuting
Acceptance of another viewpoint in a text by stating and not refuting it.

ITA-1.8.2.1 anumānam अनुमानम्
Inference based on observations
The process of inference, in which a new conclusion is reached from direct observation by applying reason.

ITA-1.8.2.2 anumitiḥ अनुमितिः
Inferential knowledge
A conclusion reached from stated premises.

ITA-1.7.5 anuyogaḥ अनुयोगः
Question
A question or query raised to challenge the expressive power and scope of a statement and to clarify any ambiguity.

ITA-1.7.6 anuyojyam अनुयोज्यम्
Questionable statement
A statement which is beset with syntactical defects and requires clarification.
ITA-

.14 anurasaḥ अनुरसः
Secondary taste
ITA-

.11 anulōmanam अनुलोमनम्
Normal course of movement
A therapeutic action which helps in the proper formation of excreta and relieves any obstruction to their downward movement; it also indicates the direction of stroke employed in a regular therapeutic oil massage.

ITA-9.2.72 anuvāsanabastiḥ अनुवासनबस्तिः
Half-dose therapeutic ghee or oily enema
A form of medicated ghee or oily enema, the dose of which is half that of therapeutic ghee or oily enema.

ITA-5.76.119 anuvāsanamityayoga अनुवासनमित्ययोग
Condition of improper administration medicated oily enema

ITA-5.76.118 anuvāsanavastyayoga/ snehavastiayoga अनुवासनवस्त्ययोग/ स्नेहवस्तिअयोग
Condition caused by inadequate or subnormal administration of medicated oily enema

ITA-5.76.152 anuvāsitasya nasya vyāpadaḥ अनुवासितस्य नस्य व्यापदः
Complications caused by inhalation therapy administered to person who has taken unctuous enema
A condition characterized by heaviness of the head.

ITA-9.6.184 anuvellitabandhaḥ अनुवेल्लितबन्धः
Spiral bandage
A type of bandage applied to the extremities in a spiral shape.

ITA-5.62.19 anuśayī अनुशयी
Deep-rooted abscess in foot
A disorder characterized by a less inflamed nodule; deeprooted lesion; lesion with tendency to suppurate internally; skin-coloured nodule; located in scalp/head.

ITA-9.6.88 anuśastram अनुशस्त्रम्
Materials and tools for parasurgical procedures
The adjunctive or complementary devices or objects used to perform parasurgical or auxiliary procedures.

ITA-9.6.101 anuśastravisrāvaṇam अनुशस्त्रविस्रावणम्
Bloodletting with adjuvants as an alternative to surgical instruments
Bloodletting by means of horn leech or bottle-gourd
